featured_reviews.name: Stiyana Fernandes
featured_reviews.review_text:
The offers displayed on the board seem misleading and only meant to attract customers. I picked up a Dove Serum Combo Bar (pack of 5) that was priced at ₹280 on the Smart Bazaar display. However, at the billing counter, the price was charged as ₹565—almost double.
When I questioned the staff, instead of providing a proper explanation, they gave vague and unsatisfactory reasons. It felt like customers were being taken for granted. What was even more surprising was that after I completed the payment and went back to check, the price tag had been completely removed from the display.
This kind of misleading pricing and lack of transparency is unacceptable and needs to be addressed.

featured_reviews.name: denzil john
featured_reviews.review_text:
Offer at smart bazar are for the customer or inhouse staff??

My experience at this location was problematic 😠. Promotional offers, such as those with significant discounts, appear to be inaccessible to customers. Store personnel reportedly acquire and conceal discounted items, preventing patrons from benefiting 🛍️. Management is allegedly aware of these practices, which is concerning 😤. This conduct diminishes trust in the establishment's integrity 📉.  there is any offer running on the product like 80% off etc the in-house staff will hide the product for them self

featured_reviews.name: Ranajit Das
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited Smart Bazaar by Reliance in Vasai West and had a great experience! The collection of clothes was impressive, with all categories available to choose from. The shopping area is massive, which made browsing and finding what I was looking for easy and enjoyable.

The checkout process was quick and efficient, with ample parking available. There is also an eatery inside, which was a nice touch.

The only downside was that the fruits and vegetables were not as fresh as I would have liked. However, this did not detract from my overall positive experience.

Overall, I highly recommend Smart Bazaar by Reliance in Vasai West for anyone looking for a great shopping experience. The variety of products available, ample parking, and fast checkout make it a convenient and enjoyable place to shop.

featured_reviews.name: Shalem
featured_reviews.review_text:

Has variety of products, however Dmart is at a throw away distance, hence prices are much more competent.

Have found the staff to be less responsive here..
Not sure if this place has a lift for shoppers, walking on the ramp is tiring...

featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited Supermarket walaz, and I must say, it was a pleasant experience from start to finish. The store was clean, well-organized, and fully stocked with a wide variety of fresh produce, groceries, household items, and more.

What stood out the most was the staff — they were polite, helpful, and always ready to assist with a smile. Billing was quick and hassle-free, even during peak hours, thanks to their efficient counter system.

The quality of fruits and vegetables was excellent, and the pricing was quite reasonable compared to other stores in the area. I also appreciated the offers and discounts available on many items.

Overall, it’s a one-stop destination for all your daily needs. Highly recommended for anyone looking for convenience, quality, and great service under one roof!

featured_reviews.name: vikrant mandiya
featured_reviews.review_text:
Big Bazaar ....as usual good collection
It's a perfect place in Vasai to get all the wide variety of groceries, even casual clothing items apart from the regular stuff this stores meat chicken n fresh fruits and vegetables

My favourite spot in this store is the bakery corner, you can get some hard to find bakery items at this joint ..from ginger breads to fresh cakes you will get a wide variety of them

Though it's near Vijay sales but it does offer a variety of electronics items ! One another interesting part of this store is the in-house sweet store that has some good collection of Bengali sweets and the newly opened food Galli that serve some fast bite items n yes the evergreen softy ...that was a nice touch !

One thing that's good about this place is the parking lot ! You can bring your car or bike without any tensions as there is always some place to park your vehicle..n that's a big relief when compared to nearby Dmart where it's very hard to find proper parking space ... You might miss the street food vendors on this store compared to D mart ...but the inside shops serve the purpose to some extent ...
